crossRefs.note: He said, “This will be the way of the king who shall reign over you: he will take your sons, and appoint them as his…
When you have come to the land which Yahweh your God gives you, and possess it and dwell in it, and say, “I will set a…
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “Let it suffice you, princes of Israel: remove violence and plunder, and execute justice and…
“You shall have just balances, a just ephah, and a just bath.
“ ‘The Lord Yahweh says: “If the prince gives a gift to any of his sons, it is his inheritance. It shall belong to his…
Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who…
for kings and all who are in high places, that we may lead a tranquil and quiet life in all godliness and reverence.
Remind them to be in subjection to rulers and to authorities, to be obedient, to be ready for every good work,
Therefore subject yourselves to every ordinance of man for the Lord’s sake: whether to the king, as supreme;
or to governors, as sent by him for vengeance on evildoers and for praise to those who do well.

people.name: Samuel
people.line: Prophet and last judge of Israel before the kings

translations.web: Then Samuel told the people the regulations of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before Yahweh. Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
translations.bsb: Then Samuel explained to the people the rights of kingship. He wrote them on a scroll and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent all the people away, each to his own home.
translations.kjv: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before the LORD. And Samuel sent ➔ all the people away, every man to his house.
translations.asv: Then Samuel told the people the manner of the kingdom, and wrote it in a book, and laid it up before Jehovah. And Samuel sent all the people away, every man to his house.
